question: For countries in Western Africa with an estimated population above 10 million, how many port points lie inside each country? Return only countries with at least one port, ordered by port count descending and then country name.
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS port_count FROM countries c JOIN ports p ON ST_Contains(c.geometry, p.geometry) WHERE c.subregion = 'Western Africa' AND c.pop_est > 10000000 GROUP BY c.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1 ORDER BY port_count DESC, c.name;

question: For countries containing at least 3 port points, calculate port density as the number of ports per 100,000 square kilometres using spheroid area. Return the top 10 countries by density, with country name, port count, area in square kilometres rounded to one decimal, and density rounded to four decimals. Break ties by country name.
sql: WITH country_port_counts AS (SELECT c.iso_a3, c.name, COUNT(*) AS port_count, ANY_VALUE(c.geometry) AS geometry FROM countries c JOIN ports p ON ST_Contains(c.geometry, p.geometry) GROUP BY c.iso_a3, c.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3) SELECT name, port_count, ROUND(ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry) / 1000000.0, 1) AS area_km2, ROUND(port_count / (ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry) / 100000000000.0), 4) AS ports_per_100k_km2 FROM country_port_counts ORDER BY ports_per_100k_km2 DESC, name LIMIT 10;

question: What is the total estimated population of countries that contain at least 3 port points whose importance rank is 5 or lower?
sql: WITH qualifying_countries AS (SELECT c.iso_a3, c.pop_est FROM countries c JOIN ports p ON ST_Contains(c.geometry, p.geometry) WHERE p.scalerank <= 5 GROUP BY c.iso_a3, c.pop_est HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3) SELECT SUM(pop_est) AS total_pop_est FROM qualifying_countries;

question: For each continent, count how many port points with a listed website lie inside its countries, and compute the average importance rank of those ports. Return only continents with at least 10 such ports, ordered by port count descending and then continent.
sql: SELECT c.continent, COUNT(*) AS port_count, ROUND(AVG(p.scalerank), 2) AS avg_scalerank FROM countries c JOIN ports p ON ST_Contains(c.geometry, p.geometry) WHERE p.website IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.continent HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY port_count DESC, c.continent;

question: For Liberia, Guinea, Czechia, and St-Barthélemy, count how many port points lie within 200 kilometres of the country centroid. Return the country name and count, ordered by count descending and then country name.
sql: WITH country_centroids AS (SELECT name, ST_Centroid(geometry) AS centroid FROM countries WHERE name IN ('Liberia', 'Guinea', 'Czechia', 'St-Barthélemy')) SELECT cc.name, COUNT(*) AS port_count FROM country_centroids cc JOIN ports p ON ST_Distance_Spheroid(p.geometry, cc.centroid) <= 200000 GROUP BY cc.name ORDER BY port_count DESC, cc.name;

question: For each European country with a GDP above 100,000 million, count how many port points lie inside the country and report the total importance rank of those ports. Return only countries with at least one port, ordered by total importance rank descending and then country name.
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS port_count, SUM(p.scalerank) AS total_scalerank FROM countries c JOIN ports p ON ST_Contains(c.geometry, p.geometry) WHERE c.continent = 'Europe' AND c.gdp_md > 100000 GROUP BY c.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1 ORDER BY total_scalerank DESC, c.name;
